customer_name: Shenzhen Bay Area Urban Construction Development Co., Ltd. (深圳湾区城市建设发展有限公司)
business_problem: Shenzhen Bay Area Urban Construction Development needed a way to coordinate many construction participants and project datasets across a very large urban-development site instead of relying on fragmented visualizations and disconnected management processes.
solution_summary: Shenzhen Bay Area Urban Construction Development built a district-wide digital coordination platform for the Shenzhen Bay Super Headquarters Base so planning and construction teams could manage a major urban project as a shared digital model instead of disconnected contractor systems. The C-Tower module combines UE4 rendering, 3D and GIS visualization, real-scene models, and video-surveillance fusion to present planning, landscape, traffic, and municipal designs in an interactive environment. The same platform tracks engineering progress, aggregates project information, and exposes decision-support views for lifecycle management. Because many participants work across a very large site, the system emphasizes data sharing, visual coordination, and lighter-weight models. The result is a common spatial and operational platform for refined planning display, full-lifecycle engineering management, and integrated project oversight.

solution_components.name: C Tower Coordination Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the district-level management surface for planning, construction, and coordination.

solution_components.name: UE4 Engine
solution_components.role: Renders the high-fidelity 3D planning and design environment used by the project teams.

solution_components.name: 3D GIS Visualization
solution_components.role: Combines spatial and project information for engineering and planning visibility.

solution_components.name: Video Surveillance Fusion
solution_components.role: Brings monitoring feeds into the 3D environment for construction oversight.

data_flow: Planning, landscape, traffic, municipal, engineering, and surveillance data are aggregated into the coordination platform, visualized through UE4 and 3D GIS layers, and then exposed as project-progress and decision-support views for lifecycle management teams.
business_outcome: The company gained a refined planning-visualization and project-governance platform that supports full-lifecycle engineering management and better cross-party coordination for a complex urban-development program.
metrics: The site covers 1.17 million square meters of land.
Total planned development area is about 5.2 million square meters.
